description: This file defines a FakeEmailService class that implements the EmailService interface. It provides mock implementations of email sending methods, logging email actions and printing message details to the console for development or testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeEmailService
classes.description: A mock implementation of an EmailService that logs email actions and prints message details to the console.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Logs and prints a simple email message with sender, recipient, and message content.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Logs and prints details of an email message sent using a Thymeleaf template, including recipient and subject.
